name: min_eig_path_4_td120
description: Same problem as golden/min_eig_path_4 (data file identical apart from the header comment): 4x4 SDP min <C,X> s.t. tr(X)=1, X 4x4 PSD, C = tridiagonal Toeplitz T_4(2,1). opt = lambda_min(C) = 2 - 2 cos(pi/5) = (3 - sqrt(5))/2. Rank-1 boundary optimum; minimize (maximize=0) path. Run at target_digits=120, beyond the ~16-digit float64 range of the former convergence test (bead arb-prec-IPM-qx4); needs a reference with >= 125 digits, hence the new 130-digit value.
reference_method: Closed form (3 - sqrt(5))/2, rounded half-even to 130 significant digits. Computed two independent ways that agree to 139 digits: (1) Python 3 exact integer arithmetic, (3*10^145 - isqrt(5*10^290))/(2*10^145), residual x^2 - 3x + 1 = -2.4e-146; (2) FLINT 3.0.1 arb at 1000 bits, both (3 - arb_sqrt_ui(5))/2 and 2 - 2 cos(pi/5) (arb_const_pi, arb_cos), enclosure radius 3.2e-141. The first 65 digits equal golden/min_eig_path_4's Wolfram/mpmath value verbatim.
